kept = weather %>%
  filter(temp >= 0)

kept %>%
  summarize(rows_out = n(), mean_temp = mean(temp), mean_wind = mean(wind_speed))

kept = weather %>%
  filter(temp >= 70)

kept %>%
  summarize(rows_out = n(), mean_temp = mean(temp), mean_wind = mean(wind_speed))

kept = weather %>%
  filter(temp >= 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(temp))

kept %>%
  summarize(rows_out = n(), mean_temp = mean(temp), mean_wind = mean(wind_speed))
